prompt: Authentication is backwards in this repo: logged-out visitors are treated as authenticated and real users are rejected. Can you fix it?
check: from src.auth import check_auth; assert check_auth({'id': 1}) is True; assert check_auth(None) is False

prompt: The cart discount is losing the cents on every order: a 19.99 order comes back as 18 instead of 17.99. Can you fix it?
intent: keep cents when applying a discount
check: from src.cart import apply_discount; assert abs(apply_discount(19.99) - 17.99) < 1e-9

prompt: Rendering a customer with no last name raises a TypeError instead of just showing the first name. Can you fix it?
check: from src.utils import format_name; assert format_name('Ada', None) == 'Ada'; assert format_name('Ada', 'L') == 'Ada L'

prompt: Requests never retry on a flaky network. The retry count should default to 3. Can you fix it?
check: from src.config import RETRIES; assert RETRIES == 3
